integrity: The original geodesic tile definition and area formula are from Liao and Wang. A proof by triangulation and exact hyperbolic vertex distances gives the two-branch diameter formula, supplemented by independently reproducible finite arithmetic checks.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicit nonconvex geodesic Zare monotiles are treated; no optimality among all tiles with fixed side count is asserted. The October 6 updated full text of the source was unavailable for direct comparison.
title: Exact diameter of the geodesic Zare monotiles
